transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. I really hope I'm not taking up too much of your time. 

Um... I guess I came in today because... well, I've been having this little issue. It's probably just stress, I don't want you to think I'm crazy or anything like that. But... lately, even when my house is completely quiet and I know for a fact nobody else is there, I keep hearing... well, I hear voices. 

It sounds as clear as somebody standing right there in my little studio with me. It says my name, and... it tells me that my work is being judged. Which is upsetting, because I really do try my best at my job, I promise I do. I'm a good worker. I just... I wanted to see if maybe there's a simple explanation for it? Am I explaining that okay for you?
Can you describe more about the voices you hear? Are they distressing to you, or do you feel neutral about them?

Oh, um... I'm sorry, I know I just sort of blurted some of that out a second ago. I hope I'm not repeating myself too much. But... like I was saying, it really is just as clear as a real person standing right there in the room with me. My house will be completely quiet, I know for a fact nobody else is around, and then... there it is. Calling my name. Telling me people are judging my work. 

You asked if it's distressing... well, I try really hard not to let it bother me. I don't want to make a big fuss or be a burden to anyone. But... yes, it does upset me a little bit, just because I take so much pride in my job. I help take care of folks, you know? I'd never do a bad job. So hearing that when I'm all alone is... well, it's a bit hard. 

I really hope I'm not sounding foolish. Am I giving you the right kind of information, doctor? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions right.
Have you ever felt that something is true or real that others don't seem to understand, even when they tell you it isn't?

Oh... um, well... I really don't want you to think badly of me, doctor. I know sometimes my imagination just gets a little... carried away. It's probably nothing, just silly thoughts. I know I shouldn't let things get to me like this. 

But... since you're asking, and I want to be a good patient for you... there was a time, recently, where I just... I got it in my head that the other home-care agency in town, and maybe some people from the local library, were... well, watching me. Watching my paintings, and looking at my client papers. 

I know how it sounds. People told me it didn't make any sense, that nobody was doing that. But... I just felt so strongly that they were trying to steal a chance that was meant for me. I just *knew* they were doing it, even when everyone said I was wrong. I'm sorry, I know that probably sounds so foolish. I try to be reasonable, I really do. Does that make sense? I hope I'm not making myself sound too... difficult.
Have you felt that certain things in your environment, like people's actions or events, were specifically directed at you, even if others didn't see it that way?

Oh, yes... um, actually, I think that's exactly what I was just trying to say a moment ago. I hope I didn't speak out of turn by bringing it up too early! But... yes, like I was just mentioning with the other home-care agency and the folks from the library. It really felt like their actions were directed right at me. 

I hate to keep harping on it, I really don't want to sound like a crazy person or a bother. But... I just felt so sure they were watching my paintings, and looking through my client papers, on purpose. Like they were specifically trying to steal that chance that was meant for me. And even when folks told me it made absolutely no sense, I just... I still knew they were doing it. It felt so real, even if nobody else saw it. 

Is that the kind of thing you mean, doctor? I'm sorry for repeating myself, I just want to make sure I'm answering you properly.
Have you experienced any other unusual beliefs or suspicions that others don't share, even when there's no clear evidence to support them?

Oh... um, no, I don't think so. I really hope I'm not leaving anything important out, but... no, I think that's really all there is. Just the voices and... and that silly business with the agency and the library. 

I try really hard to keep my head down and just do my work, you know? I don't want to be the kind of person who goes around making up wild stories or causing trouble. I just want to be helpful to my clients. So... no, I haven't had any other thoughts like that. I hope that's an okay answer? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need, doctor.
Have you ever believed something so strongly that you didn’t doubt it at all, even when there was no proof or even if others showed you evidence against it?

Oh, um... yes, doctor. I know I'm probably starting to sound like a broken record, and I really apologize for that. I don't mean to be repetitive or difficult. But... yes, it's just like I was saying before about the other agency and the library folks. 

I just... I believed it so completely. Even when my friends and family told me there was absolutely no proof, and that they wouldn't care about my paintings or my client papers... I just couldn't let it go. I *knew* they were trying to steal that opportunity from me. I didn't doubt it for a second, even when everyone else was showing me how silly it sounded. 

I know now that I shouldn't have been so stubborn about it. I feel quite embarrassed, honestly. I hope you don't think I'm completely unreasonable for getting so stuck on that idea. I really do try to listen to people when they tell me I'm wrong. Is it okay that I'm just giving you the same example again? I just want to make sure I'm answering exactly what you're asking.

Have you ever had any other strong beliefs or suspicions that other people didn’t share, even when there was no real proof, and that weren’t related to the situation you already described with the home-care agency and the library?

Oh... no, doctor. I really, truly don't think so. I know I keep bringing up the same thing about the other agency and the library people... I'm so sorry, I must sound like a broken record by now. I hope you aren't getting frustrated with me. 

But really, that was the only time. Just that silly idea that they were watching my paintings and going through my client papers to steal my opportunity. I know I was completely stuck on it, and it was wrong of me to be so stubborn when everyone was telling me it didn't make sense. But I promise, I haven't had any other thoughts like that. I try very hard to be sensible and not make a fuss about things. 

I really hope that's alright, that I don't have another example for you? I'm trying my best to give you the information you need.

Have you ever had any experiences where you believed something was happening or was real, that other people didn’t seem to notice or agree with—even if it wasn’t related to the other agency or the library situation?

Oh, um... well, I know you said besides the agency and the library, but... honestly, doctor, that really is the only thing that comes to mind. I'm so sorry, I know I'm not giving you anything new here. I hope you aren't disappointed in my answers. 

It's just... I really did get it into my head that they were doing that. The folks from the other home-care agency and the library, I mean. I was just so certain they were watching my paintings, and... and going through my client papers. I thought they were trying to steal a chance that was meant for me. And even when my family and friends told me it made no sense, I just... I still knew they were doing it. 

I know it sounds so foolish now, and I feel terrible for having made such a fuss about it. I really am usually a very reasonable person. I try to be good at my job and not cause trouble. So... no, I haven't had anything else like that happen. Just that one big misunderstanding. Is it okay that I don't have anything else to tell you about that? I really want to make sure I'm doing this right.

Have you ever seen, felt, or sensed anything that others around you didn’t seem to notice—like seeing something that wasn’t there or feeling something on your skin when nothing was actually touching you?

Oh... um. Well, seeing or feeling things, no, definitely not. I promise I don't see things that aren't there. I know that sounds very... well, very concerning, and I wouldn't want you to think I was imagining things like that. 

But... well, I suppose... I mean, the reason I actually came in to see you... I hope this doesn't sound too strange, doctor. I really try to keep things quiet and not bother anyone. But lately, when I'm just sitting in my little studio area with my paintings, and the house is completely quiet... I've been hearing things. 

Just... voices. They sound so clear, exactly like someone is standing right there in the room with me. They say my name, and... and they tell me my work is being judged. Even when I know for a fact nobody else is home. 

I know it sounds awful, and I'm so embarrassed to even admit it out loud. I don't want you to think I'm losing my mind or anything. It's just a little stress, probably, right? Do you think that's normal when someone is under a lot of pressure? I really hope I'm not making too much of a fuss over it.

Have you ever had any other unusual experiences where you strongly believed something that wasn’t true, that wasn’t related to hearing voices or thinking you were being watched by the agency or library people?

Oh, um... well... I don't know if this is exactly what you mean. I really don't want to sound arrogant or anything, because I know I'm just a personal care aide and I haven't even finished high school, but... 

Well, for a little while there, I... I got it into my head that my paintings were really something special. Like, truly extraordinary. I was just so sure that my artwork was going to get discovered any day now. And... and I started thinking that I was supposed to build this whole new care-and-art program. I thought it was going to be so important that doctors and agencies would actually come to learn from me. 

I know it sounds so silly now, and I'm a bit ashamed I let myself get so carried away. I really don't usually think so highly of myself, I promise. I just wanted to help people and share my art. It was just a phase of feeling very... very inspired, I suppose. Is it okay that I thought that? It doesn't make me sound too full of myself, does it?

Have you ever had any other unusual or strong beliefs that weren't based in reality, that you held onto even when others didn't understand or tried to tell you otherwise, and that weren't related to the voices you've been hearing or your concerns about being watched?

Oh, um... no, doctor. No, I don't think so. I mean, besides what I already told you about the agency and my paintings... there really hasn't been anything else. 

I really try to keep my feet on the ground, you know? I don't want you to think I just go around making up all these wild stories in my head. I know the things I told you already probably sound like quite a lot, and I feel so terrible for taking up your time with all my... my foolishness. But I promise, I don't have any other strange ideas like that. 

I'm really trying to be helpful and answer everything you ask. Is that alright? I hope I'm not leaving anything out that you need to know. I just... I don't have anything else like that to report.

Have you ever had a strong belief or idea that you knew was true at the time, but later realized wasn’t actually real or accurate, and wasn’t related to the voices, your artwork, or the feeling of being watched?

Oh, um... no, doctor. Truly, I can't think of anything else like that. 

I know you've asked a few times now, and I feel just awful that I keep saying no... I hope you don't think I'm being difficult or hiding things from you. I really am trying to be as honest and cooperative as I can be. 

It's just... besides the things we've already talked about, my mind is usually very quiet and ordinary. I just go to work, help my clients, and come home to my little studio. I don't have any other big, strange ideas, I promise. 

I really hope I'm giving you the answers you need. I'm doing okay, aren't I? I just don't want to be a bother or make things more complicated than they need to be.
Have you ever had a belief that something very strange or impossible was true, like something out of a science fiction movie or fantasy story, that you were absolutely sure about at the time?

Oh, um... like a movie? No, no, nothing like aliens or... or magic or anything like that. I really wouldn't want you to think I was completely losing my grip on reality. 

I mean, the only thing... and I know I already mentioned this, and I feel so silly bringing it up again because I know how it sounds... but the only thing was that business with the other home-care agency and the people from the library. 

I just... I was so certain they were watching me. Watching my paintings, looking at my client papers. I thought they were trying to steal this... this big chance that was meant for me. And I know people tried to tell me it didn't make any sense, that they wouldn't do that. But at the time, I just *knew* they were. It felt so real to me. 

But it wasn't like a science fiction movie, I promise. Just... a misunderstanding, I suppose. I really hope I'm not sounding too crazy by repeating it. I'm just trying to answer your question the best I can... is that what you meant?

Have you ever had any other strong, unshakable beliefs that weren't based on reality, that weren't related to the voices, your artwork, or the feeling of being watched, and that you held onto for a long time even without proof?

Oh, um... well, I know you've asked this a few different ways, and I really, truly don't want to frustrate you. I promise I'm not trying to hold anything back or be difficult... 

It's just, like I was saying before, the only thing that really fits what you're asking is... well, the thing about the other agency and the library people. I know we've gone over it, and I feel just awful bringing it up yet again. I don't want you to think I'm completely obsessed with it or that I'm, you know, totally unhinged. 

It was just... I was so sure they were looking at my client papers and watching my paintings, trying to take away this big chance that was supposed to be mine. And I know folks tried to tell me it didn't make any sense, that I was just getting worked up over nothing. But I held onto it for so long, even when they said I had no proof. I just *knew* they were doing it, deep down. 

But besides that one misunderstanding... there really isn't anything else. I try to be so careful and keep my head down. I hope it's alright that I don't have any other examples for you. I'm really trying to give you what you need... am I doing okay?

Have you ever had any beliefs that something very strange or impossible was happening, like something that most people would find hard to believe, even if it wasn’t related to the voices or the feeling of being watched?

Oh, goodness... I know you're trying so hard to get to the bottom of this, and I feel just terrible that I keep giving you the same answer. I really hope I'm not testing your patience. I want to be a good patient for you, I really do.

It's just... well, the only thing that comes to mind is what I mentioned before. And I know it sounds a bit strange, which is why I feel so embarrassed bringing it up again. I don't want you to think I'm making a habit of believing impossible things. 

But it was just that time when I got it in my head that the other home-care agency and some people from the local library were... well, watching me. Watching my paintings, and looking at my client papers. I was just so convinced they were trying to steal this wonderful chance that was meant for me. 

And, you know, my friends and folks around me told me it made absolutely no sense, that it was impossible. But I just... I still knew they were doing it. It felt so real at the time. 

I'm so sorry if that's not exactly what you're looking for, or if you're tired of hearing about it. I really don't have anything else like that to share. I hope that's okay? I'm doing my best to answer you properly...
Have you ever had any beliefs that were so strange or impossible that even other people who heard about them would find them hard to understand or completely out of touch with reality?

Oh, dear... I feel like a broken record, and I am so, so sorry. I know you're asking this in different ways to make sure you get the whole picture, and I really appreciate how thorough you are. I don't want you to think I'm holding anything back, I promise I'm not.

It's just... well, it's that same thing again. I feel so silly even saying it out loud another time, because I know how completely out of touch it sounds now. I really don't want you to think I'm the sort of person who just makes up wild stories.

But... yes, it was just that business with the other home-care agency and the library people. I just had it in my head that they were keeping tabs on me—looking at my paintings, going through my client papers. I was just absolutely certain they were trying to steal this... this big opportunity that I thought was meant for me. 

And you're right, when I told people about it, they couldn't understand it at all. They told me it was impossible, that it made no sense for them to care about my things. But at the time, no matter what anyone said, I just... I knew they were doing it. 

I'm so sorry, I know that's the same answer I keep giving you. There just isn't anything else that fits what you're asking. I hope I'm not making your job too difficult by repeating myself... am I still giving you the information you need?

Have you ever had any beliefs that were so strange or clearly not based in reality that even you now recognize them as completely impossible, and weren't related to the voices or your concerns about being watched?

Oh, Dr... I... I really don't know what else to say, and I feel just awful that I can't give you a new answer. I promise I'm trying my very best to be helpful, I really am. I don't want you to be disappointed in me.

It's just... well, it always comes back to that same exact thing. And I know you asked for something *not* related to being watched, but... the only time I ever believed something that I can look back on now and say, "Oh, my, that was just impossible," was that whole situation with the other home-care agency and the library people. 

I know I've said it so many times... I just got it in my head that they were looking at my paintings and my client papers, trying to steal that special chance that was supposed to be mine. And looking back now, I do see how... well, how strange it sounds. Even when everyone told me it made no sense, I just couldn't let it go. I really believed it back then. 

But I promise you, I don't go around believing impossible things all the time. That was just a... a bad patch, I suppose. I'm so sorry I don't have a different example for you. I hope you're not too frustrated with me... am I doing alright answering your questions?
